findings: All seven registered contrasts use differences of arm CE, not CE of within-pair differences.
One multinomial fit draw and one independent cluster draw are shared by all methods and both nested draws; CPU bootstrap uses 99999 replicates in the ordinary CLI.
Seven Bonferroni percentile intervals use lower floor and upper ceil order statistics; finite-sample coverage remains approximate and explicitly disclaimed.
Frozen capture roster/digests, exact full coordinates, physical event ownership/deduplication, all explicit categories and known tariff meters are structurally checked.
Missing/rejected/failed/unselected work cannot be silently removed from an already independently pinned capture payload; JSON commitments alone do not prove original capture completeness.
All six readiness gates remain OPEN; readiness never grants dispatch or update, and analysis always reports confirmation=false/no_update=true.
32 fit blocks and two draws per source are distinguished from independent new images or 32 independently trained control models.
limits: Source review and synthetic scalar arithmetic are not R2 model, training or evaluation results.
New utility weights, MDE, quality floors, power method and N grid are reviewable choices, not a fully sealed or empirically validated design.
Real trainer, independent evaluator/custody, actual strong-baseline implementations, new test data, resource allocation and candidate bytes remain absent.
The accounting report selected_and_unselected_cost covers episode costs only; outer lifecycle costs are separately unamortized. Preserve this distinction in presentation.
No signature verification, actual OS isolation, rare-error floor inference, real power demonstration or promotion owner is implemented by these tools.
